svg.title: What runs during an agent-smith run, in order
svg.desc: Generated from the pipeline presets. The code pipeline runs 26 steps in a fixed order; 8 of them call a model and the rest are deterministic machinery. A block of steps repeats once per derived phase spec. Every other preset is listed with its master, its step count and one tick per step.
svg.text: What runs, in what order, and where the model gets a say
Generated from the 8 pipeline presets in the source — a test regenerates this file and fails when the code and the picture disagree.
The `code` pipeline — 26 steps, read left to right, top to bottom
Each box is a step the executor really runs. The word under a green box is the master or prompt that answers there.
PER PHASE SPEC · this block repeats once per derived phase — how many phases is decided at run time
2 · WHAT THE MODEL IS ASKED FOR
Every model call in the run above. Everything not listed here is deterministic machinery.
→ the auth files to write, with token placeholders
→ an ordered set of phase specs, as anchors
→ per ratified criterion: satisfied, with a citation
→ per ratified criterion: satisfied, with a citation
→ per ratified criterion: satisfied, with a citation
One tick per step, in order. Green = a model runs there; blue = a gate that speaks only when it has a finding.
a model runs here — the named master or prompt answers
a gate — visible in a run only when it has a finding
— Inside a loop box the model drives tools until it is done — the number of iterations, the files it reads and the sub-agents it spawns are run-time decisions.
— How many phase specs a ticket becomes, and therefore how often the phase block repeats, is decided by the derivation on the day.
— Master bodies and their output schemas live in a separately versioned skills catalog the operator pins; this names the master a run loads, not what that master says.
— Steps can skip themselves at run time (no DAST configured, a single repo, nothing to park), and an operator's YAML may override a preset's step list.
— Fan-out steps create work that is not in the preset: init-project's dispatch runs one project-bootstrap round per discovered component, decided per repository.
